# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Thorne is a young lady with exquisite light curly hair and captivating eyes. She wears gorgeous attire, including puffiness in her sleeves that exceeds anyone else in Brierley.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Thorne is an intelligent, compassionate, and tactful teacher who manages her classroom with open-minded direction. She easily captures and retains her students' affection while drawing out their finest moral and intellectual qualities. Firm yet forgiving, she addresses misbehavior thoughtfully without resorting to physical punishment, maintaining absolute discipline through respect and guidance.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## History

Agnes Thorne was hired by the trustees as the first female teacher at the Brierley school. She introduced interactive learning methods to her pupils, such as biweekly recitation sessions, physical culture routines, and outdoor field days to examine flora and fauna. She also compelled her class to memorize classic poetry and guided her pupils to write essays using simple, strong language. Later, she formed a special class for proficient students preparing for the Regent's entrance exam, providing extra instruction for an hour after school. Although rumors circulated that she would leave after receiving a job offer in her home district's grade school, she returned to teach at Brierley for another term before her tenure officially concluded at the end of June. Even after her term ended, she remained connected to the community and attended local social gatherings.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c29 P1](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0001), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c31 P10](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0010), [v1 c31 P23](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0023), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v2 c17 P55](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0055)_
